items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: And Jimmy Pala, see he was from Algeist too, he was leading the band there. He was from Algeist. That was before Pete was leading.

ctx.x: No, Gabriel. I mean, which brother played with him? Bebe. Bebe. Bebe. Or Remus, my brother Remus, the oldest brother, he never did worry about trap drum. They used to be bass drum and snare drum. On the street post, right? He's the one you put in. He's the one you put in. He's the one you put in. Bass drum and snare drum. He was good at both of them. So that's why when I first seen my brother play trap drum, it was with Old Man Lindsey playing. He played a penny party. See? And he had Dude on clarinet. Johnny…
Where did you live in Algiers? What street?
